faq.question: How long does this conversation take?
What happens with my answers?
faq.answer: They are written down in your own words, checked for completeness and stored for the investment team, who review them.

faq.question: What happens after this conversation?
faq.answer: The investment team reviews your conversation and gets in touch with you.

faq.question: Can I correct something I said?
faq.answer: Yes, just say so at any time during the conversation.

faq.question: What if I don't know an answer or don't want to share it?
faq.answer: Just say so. If you don't know, I may ask once for a rough estimate; otherwise it is noted, and the conversation continues.

faq.question: Why do you ask follow-up questions?
faq.answer: To make sure every topic is complete: when an answer stays open, I ask once right away, and if something is still missing at the end, a few short follow-up questions follow. There is at most one follow-up per question.

faq.question: Can I stop the conversation?
faq.answer: Yes. Just tell me, and I write down what you said so far and we finish here. The STOPP button also ends it at any time, but then the conversation is saved as unfinished, and a new attempt needs a new access code from the team.

faq.question: Is the conversation recorded?
faq.answer: The transcript is stored, the audio is not.
